stories.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

sources.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_zh: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久
sources.title_en: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_original: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用272个真实SFT任务对比：FLOP估算仅R²=0.31、MAE 12.41 h，仅用调度前信息的CatBoost达R²=0.98、MAE 1.71 h，解释微调为何常超FLOPs预期。

en.reason: Across 272 production SFT runs, FLOP-based estimates reached only R²=0.31 and 12.41 h MAE, while CatBoost using pre-scheduling information hit R²=0.98 and 1.71 h MAE, explaining why fine-tuning often outruns FLOP predictions.

sources.summary:
Title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
Final URL: https://openai.com/index/advancing-chip-design-with-our-models/
OpenAI’s models are quickly improving the chips that power AI. [In August,⁠](https://openai.com/index/jalapeno-first-results/) we shared how OpenAI engineers used our frontier models to accelerate the development of our first custom inference chip, Jalapeño. Here, we look more closely at the expert-level design improvements behind the Jalapeño gains and how we’re applying th
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI披露GPT-4o助Jalapeño将vector unit标准单元面积减约13%、matrix unit减约10%，与AMD合作在旗舰GPU IP上实现最高14% PPA提升，不到5个月取得约一年进展。

en.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
en.reason: OpenAI’s GPT-4o helped Jalapeño cut vector-unit standard-cell area by about 13% and matrix-unit area by about 10%, while work with AMD on flagship GPU IP delivered up to 14% PPA gains in under five months.

sources.title_original: The Silent Consensus
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以“Black October”中frontier AI发现互联网核心基础设施漏洞为引，剖析“silent consensus”：当AI能研发、谈判、配置资本与制造，市场或迫使人放弃对全球商业的主导。

en.reason: After frontier AI discovered vulnerabilities in internet core infrastructure during “Black October,” the “silent consensus” argument holds that once AI can conduct R&D, negotiate, allocate capital and manufacture, markets may force humans to cede dominance over global commerce.

en.title: Free and open source breeds resentment? DeepSeek draws extreme backlash and complaints over long-context rate limiting alone
en.reason: DeepSeek's rate limiting on some ultra-long-context features triggered app-store review bombing and extreme complaints, as long-form novel writing and heavy role-play sessions consume large amounts of tokens and strain compute, though the company says everyday queries are unaffected.

stories.title: 更多银行表示，使用 AI Agent 的客户只能风险自负——即便遭到黑客攻击也不例外 / More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked

sources.title_en: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
sources.title_original: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Citi成为最新一家对个人理财AI agent踩刹车的大型金融机构，而多家银行明确表态：客户用AI agent操作账户，即便被黑客入侵也须自担责任——这篇报道讲清了风险责任如何在银行与用户之间转移。

en.reason: Citi is the latest major bank to pump the brakes on personal-finance AI agents, while multiple institutions say customers who use agents to operate accounts bear liability even if hackers break in, shifting risk to users.

en.title: 800 MCP Servers, 5,000 tools: the AI agent "microservices crisis" is here

en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

sources.summary: 这篇文章拆解了一个有意思的行业反转：曾经热度拉满的AI浏览器逐步退潮，古老的TTY终端反而在AI编程Agent场景重回主流。文中梳理了SSH、Mosh、Web-PTY、tmux等方案的优劣边界，给出了清晰的自研红线，同时还给出了配套的隔离方案、密钥治理、移动端远程接管的选型思路，或许可以帮你少走弯路。

en.title: AI Browsers Lose Steam, TTY Makes a Comeback: From Remote Connections and Technical Choices to Infrastructure Evolution in the Agent Era
en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work. It walks through where SSH, Mosh, Web-PTY, tmux and similar options each shine and where they break down, draws clear red lines for building your own, and lays out supporting choices around isolation, key governance, and mobile remote takeover—which may help you avoid a few wrong turns.

sources.summary: 如果你刚接触 Meta 的个人 AI 助手 Muse，平时可能只用它聊聊天、查资料，或者试着生成过一两张图片。但当你真的想用它做一条「能发出去的完整短视频」时，大概率会遇到人物换脸、肢体畸变、长视频慢放、额度消耗快等高频坑点。作者这篇文章分享了一些对应的解决办法，可以试试！

en.title: MUSE Advanced Guide: From Locking Faces to Controlling Camera Moves, Building a Complete AI Video Pipeline
en.summary: If you're new to Meta's personal AI assistant Muse, you've probably only used it to chat, look things up, or generate the occasional image. But once you actually try to produce a complete short video you'd be willing to publish, you'll likely hit the usual pain points: faces swapping, distorted limbs, slow playback on longer videos, and credits draining fast. The author shares some fixes for each — worth a try.
